kapak.alt: Red flags in the dizzy patient

youtube.baslik: When should testing stop for a dizzy patient? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In a dizzy patient, new severe headache or neck pain, double vision, speech disturbance, numbness in the face or arm, and inability to stand even with help are urgent signs. If any of these red flags is present, do not try to complete the planned test battery; refer the patient for emergency physician evaluation without delay.
